retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style urban layout featuring a lone figure against massive neoclassical stone architecture with bold, slanted sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle wide shot of a man standing on a wet city sidewalk next to a street sign, framed by the towering columns and stone facade of a neoclassical building that recedes into a deep perspective.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical street sign pole bisects the composition, grounding the central figure.
The receding perspective of the building facade creates a strong diagonal leading to the left.
Bold, italicized typography is layered over the upper third of the architectural background.
The figure's scale is dwarfed by the massive stone blocks and columns.
coreInvariants: Neoclassical architectural backdrop with visible stone texture
Deep linear perspective receding to one side
Bold, slanted sans-serif display type in the upper quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-full shot of a male figure positioned centrally in the lower half, appearing small against the architecture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical street sign pole and the 'One Way' sign acting as a central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold red and yellow text at the top, follow the vertical pole down to the figure, then move along the receding perspective of the building to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast, textured stone wall of the building provides a neutral field for the text and figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted grays and beiges from the stone architecture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and the 'One Way' sign.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and bright yellow for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with high-saturation, medium-value text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic weight pairing using color to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century American sans-serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a man in a trench coat standing on a wet city sidewalk next to a street sign pole. Behind him is a massive neoclassical stone building with large columns and a deep perspective receding to the left. The lighting is overcast and the colors are muted grays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase, italicized sans-serif text in the top left quadrant. Use bright red for the top line and bright yellow for the second line. Ensure the text is tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Is the text slanted to the right?
Is the building's perspective clearly receding?
Are the colors of the text vibrant against the gray background?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'One Way' sign is legible and oriented correctly.
Verify the text does not obscure the figure's face.
Ensure the architectural lines converge naturally.
Confirm the red and yellow colors are punchy and saturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Architecture + Deep Perspective + Bold Italic Sans-Serif = 70s Editorial Aesthetic
